_comment: Service template: one entry per supported anatomy_projection. do_preparation.py reads the entry matching the requested anatomy/projection, injects the runtime mpp (or falls back to the default below) and resolved paths, and writes a per-job config consumed by do_matching + do_measurements. References are single-orientation, so there are no left/right entries. 'reference_dir' is the subfolder under the references root (defaults to the entry key if omitted). CURRENTLY ENABLED: knee_lateral, knee_axial. Others (knee_ap, feet_lateral, feet_ap, shoulder_ap, shoulder_y, hip_ap) will be added once their reference sets are available.
